name: Rand Hall iteration 6: south elevation v2 (AI draft)

items.text: Steel daylight-factory sash: three units an opening, panes about 1'-6" x 1'-6", a pivoting vent in the middle unit (pane count assumed)
Light stone: water table, sill bands, cornice band, coping
Sawtooth ridge just over the parapet (assumed)
ITERATION 6: SOUTH ELEVATION, SECOND PASS (1/4"=1'-0"). Piers, stone bands, brick spandrels and the steel sash drawn. This is the face chosen for the isometric.
